correctness.rationale: Conditioning on a collision-free prefix of length b yields exactly b observed coupon types, hence E[cover time|first collision after b]=b+m H_(m-b). Summing covariance against the tail indicators for the first-collision time (including the m+1 endpoint) yields the strictly negative finite sum. Independently, conditioning on the actual first-collision index b yields b plus independent geometric waiting stages and a strict first-order stochastic ordering, with m+1 handled separately. Gaussian domination for b up to m/2 and exponentially small survival for b>m/2 justify the Riemann-sum limit -sqrt(pi/8). Rayleigh moment convergence and the exact variance of independent geometric collection stages give the m-scaled correlation constant. A standalone exact-rational verifier cross-checks two genuinely different covariance recurrences for all m=2..60, and 1947 rational identities/inequalities; this is supplemental to the analytic proof.

originality.rationale: The motivating classical literature establishes the separate first-repeat/birthday and coupon-completion marginal laws and the independent geometric-stage construction, but the inspected primary sections do not state or logically imply the quantitative joint dependence theorem: first-collision-index-conditioned stochastic order, exact strictly negative covariance, and the sharp inverse-m correlation rate. Multiple targeted semantic searches yielded adjacent but different occupancy and birthday statements, none with matching joint objects and quantifiers. The claim uses known marginal tools; the contribution lies in deriving their nontrivial joint mixed-moment law. This is a best-knowledge priority judgment, with residual risk of an equivalent uninspected old occupancy result. Holst (1986) is a highly relevant general birthday/coupon framework whose original full text was inaccessible; the abstract appears to study generic single stopping times, not this paired mixed moment, but historical coverage is not asserted.
residual_risks: Historical priority might be affected by older joint birthday/coupon occupancy work outside inspected primary sections or unavailable scans.

value.rationale: First birthday collision and the full coupon collection time are canonical stopping times of the same occupancy path. Their usual marginal scales (sqrt(m) and m log(m)) alone give no cross-dependence information. The theorem supplies an all-size strict stochastic ordering, a manifest-sign exact mixed-moment formula and an unusual rate m^(-1) of correlation with a sharp explicit constant; the conditional-mean profile explains the cancellation. These are structurally meaningful quantitative joint facts, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of one classical marginal table.
